name: How long does the waterfront home valuation process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the waterfront home valuation process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical waterfront home valuation process usually involves an initial property inspection, which can take 1-2 hours depending on the home's size and complexity. Following the inspection, our team analyzes comparable sales data, property features, and market conditions. The complete report is generally delivered within 3-5 business days after the site visit. The timing can vary slightly based on the unique characteristics of the property and current market activity in areas like Palm Beach or Collier County.
acceptedAnswer.description: The valuation process includes a 1-2 hour inspection, followed by analysis, with the full report delivered within 3-5 business days.
